paragraphs: Eptura sells software for running physical workplaces, facilities and assets, aimed at organizations that operate buildings and want one view of them. One app handles enterprise asset management for teams tracking and maintaining physical assets across facilities, fleets and field operations.

Other apps cover workplace experience and resource scheduling, letting teams plan their week and book space. A workplace operations app handles space management, office moves and daily operations for real estate teams. The company says the apps sit on a single shared architecture, and an AI layer turns operational data into business intelligence.

For public agencies the company points to Archibus for Government, an integrated workplace management system it describes as FedRAMP Authorized. The government pitch is visibility into an agency's full facility and space portfolio, with audit-ready asset reporting. The company also states it was named a Leader for a second year in the Gartner Magic Quadrant.

quote.text: Eptura consolidates workplace, asset, and facilities data into one platform, cutting wasted space and extending asset life.
